ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the right side of the image is a production flow chart of a coastal iron and steel base; near the iron and steel production link, “building materials factory” is marked, and links related to waste treatment and utilization such as “three wastes” and “treatment plant” also appear in the flow. Then infer: the question only asks about the environmental significance “in terms of waste utilization,” so the building materials factory being close to the iron and steel base can use waste such as slag produced by iron and steel production nearby as raw materials for building materials, turning waste into resources.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：右侧流程图显示钢铁基地的生产流程，建材厂布局在钢铁生产环节附近，并与废弃物或“三废”处理环节相联系。再结合题干只问“废弃物利用方面”的环境意义，判断建材厂可以利用钢铁基地产生的废渣等废弃物作原料，因此结论为“废弃物资源化”。
